info.title: Sharpe API
info.description:
Institutional-grade crypto market data API. Access funding rates, futures, arbitrage opportunities, narratives, ecosystems, and more.

Authentication is supported via two production-safe methods:
1. **Bearer token** in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`
2. **X-API-Key header**: `X-API-Key: sk_live_...`

API keys in query parameters are rejected by default because URLs are commonly stored in logs, browser history, analytics tools, and referrer headers.

These `/v1` endpoints send no CORS headers and must be called from a server: calling them from a browser would expose your API key in page JavaScript. The free, keyless `/api/*` endpoints do allow cross-origin browser requests (https://www.sharpe.ai/docs/free-api).

post.description: Runs a bounded query against a cataloged Sharpe Data Ocean dataset. Accepts only registered dataset IDs, whitelisted fields, filter operators, sort fields, and opaque cursors.

get.description: Returns the spot-margin borrow rate of every coin the venues price without an account: Binance (VIP 0 cross-margin daily rate), OKX (basic daily rate), Bybit (No VIP hourly rate) and Gate.io (unified-account hourly rate, the 100 enabled currencies with the most USDT spot volume). Rates are fractions: hourlyRate per hour, annualRate = hourlyRate × 8,760 (simple). One row per coin with every venue's quote, cheapest first; a venue that does not price a coin is absent, never 0. `venues` reports each venue's status (ok, stale, failed, unsupported) with its fetch time. KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC, BingX, HTX and CoinEx publish no keyless borrow rate.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Borrowed asset, case-insensitive (BTC, USDT, PEPE).

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Comma-separated venues, case-insensitive: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate.io (KuCoin, Bitget, MEXC, BingX, HTX and CoinEx are accepted and reported unsupported). Default: all.

get.description: Returns live CEX spot-transfer arbitrage routes after exact network matching (ambiguous network names are refused), token-contract matching, withdrawal/deposit status and minimums, withdrawal fees, per-venue taker fees, executable depth and slippage. Routes netting above zero come first; up to 50 near-miss routes that do not clear fees follow as indicative (`below_fees`). `meta.transferScan` counts the coins, venues and routes the scan evaluated. Same-ticker contract mismatches fail closed.

200.description: CEX spot-transfer scanner rows (executable and indicative) returned successfully.

get.description: Returns cross-exchange funding differentials across every funding venue and asset class — crypto plus RWA perps (equity, commodity, FX, index). Legs pair within one instrument-master asset (BONK, 1000BONK and KBONK are one; prices compared per asset unit), never across asset classes. One row per coin: the executable pair with the highest net APR, else the best pair whose only gap is unreported depth (`no_depth`), else the largest gross differential. netFundingRate is the per-period differential at intervalHours (the faster leg's cadence). Spread uses real order books where both legs expose one (spreadSource "book") and reference prices otherwise ("reference"). A row is executable when its spread is book-priced, its legs are within 5% of each other, both quotes are fresh and top-of-book depth reported by BOTH venues covers $10,000 (unknown depth is indicative `no_depth`, never executable); executable rows rank first by netApr — gross less both venues' taker fees and the adverse entry spread over a 30-day hold, present only on book-priced rows — then `no_depth` rows, then the other indicative rows, each by netApr where present, else gross annualized differential (apr). Unknown spread, open interest or volume are null, never zero.

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of venues to compare. Omit for every funding venue in the funding tracker's registry that the instrument master does not mark not live (`X-Data-Venues` lists them).

parameters.name: assetClass
parameters.description: Underlying filter: "all" (default), "crypto", or "rwa" (equity, commodity, FX and index perps).

parameters.name: minOiUsd
parameters.description: Minimum open interest in USD on the smaller leg. Default 0 (no floor). Legs with unknown OI fail a positive floor, and so does a leg on a venue left out of the API's open-interest totals (MEXC).

parameters.name: minVolUsd
parameters.description: Minimum 24h perp volume in USD on the smaller leg. Default 0 (no floor). Legs with unknown volume fail a positive floor.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Narrative filter: only crypto coins in that narrative's CoinGecko category (the constituents /api/narratives/data lists). Omit or "all" for every coin. A coin the category does not list, and every RWA perp, is left out when a sector is set.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many rows, the first in board order (executable rows first by netApr, then `no_depth` rows, then the rest, each by netApr or apr). Default: every row. On v1 a limited answer carries `pagination`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.cursor` (100 rows a page when `limit` is omitted).

get.description: Returns cash-and-carry rows priced at spot ask and futures bid across Binance, OKX and Bybit (Deribit has no spot leg, so it appears only in calendar spreads). Rows at least 3 days from expiry rank first; within them executable rows at the requested notional, then rows executable on a live read (`snapshot_quote`), then the rest, each by fee-adjusted net APR. Reference-only rows are omitted. Days to expiry are recomputed from the expiry on every request. The per-coin aggregate covers only contracts at least three days from expiry.

get.summary: Preview validated DEX scanner gross-spread candidates
get.description: Resolves one or two GeckoTerminal liquidity pool URLs, verifies canonical token identity, and compares DEX pool mids against CEX bid/ask books or another verified DEX pool. Returns gross quote-spread candidates, blocked states, source timestamps, and explicit warnings; it does not return executable net profit.

parameters.name: poolUrl
parameters.description: GeckoTerminal pool URL, for example https://www.geckoterminal.com/eth/pools/0x...

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Comma-separated CEX list. Supported values: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate.io, MEXC, KuCoin, Bitget, HTX, BingX, CoinEx.

parameters.name: minProfitPct
parameters.description: Minimum gross quote-spread percentage to mark a validated row as a candidate. This is not a net-profit threshold.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Scanner mode. Use cex_dex for CEX-vs-DEX comparison or dex_dex to compare two DEX pools.

parameters.name: secondPoolUrl
parameters.description: Required when mode=dex_dex. Both pools must resolve to the same canonical network and target-token contract.

parameters.name: tier2Exchanges
parameters.description: Deprecated compatibility parameter. Extended exchanges without verified live providers return explicit warnings and no rows.

parameters.name: includeFundingLeg
parameters.description: Set to true to include funding-leg context when the scanner can match a relevant perpetual market.

get.description: Returns every live Pendle Boros funding-rate market (one per venue perp and maturity: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate, KuCoin, Hyperliquid incl. the xyz builder dex, Lighter) with its implied (fixed) APR, the floating APR Boros reports, and Sharpe's own realised 7-day and 30-day funding for the same venue contract, annualised (acc × 365 / days). spread7dApr and spread30dApr are implied − realised: positive means locking the fixed rate beats what the floating leg has paid (the lock-fixed-carry signal). Gross of Boros and venue fees. A market whose venue contract is not in the funding store keeps its Boros figures and serves realised null with a reason, never 0. Ranked by spread30dApr, then spread7dApr.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Underlying asset, case-insensitive (BTC, ETH, HYPE, BRENTOIL).

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Filter to one venue, case-insensitive: Boros's name (Binance, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, Kucoin, Lighter, Bybit) or our funding store's (Gate.io, KuCoin, tradeXYZ).

200.description: Boros fixed vs floating funding returned successfully.

get.summary: Funding spread history and carry backtest
get.description: Returns a pair's historical funding spread and a carry backtest from stored settlements: a spot-perp carry on one venue (spot pays no funding) or a cross-exchange carry (long one perp, short another). The legs are aligned by settlement time (a 1h leg against an 8h leg reads the 8h settlement for each hour it covers), intervals come from the settlements themselves, never an assumed 8h. Backtests over 1-90 days sum the settlements in the window, charge each venue's entry and exit taker fees once, and report net return, annualized net APR, days with negative carry, max drawdown of cumulative carry and coverage. Borrow interest for a short-spot leg is not included.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `spot-perp`: one venue's spot and perp (needs `venue`). `cross-exchange`: a long perp and a short perp (needs `longVenue` and `shortVenue`).

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Base coin, for example BTC.

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Spot-perp venue: Binance, OKX, Bybit, Bitget, Gate.io, KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, HTX or CoinEx.

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Spot-perp: the venue's perp contract symbol, for example BTCUSDT. Optional: without it the venue's contract for the coin with the largest current open interest is used.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Spot-perp: `short` buys spot and shorts the perp (collects positive funding); `long` sells spot and longs the perp (borrow interest not included).

parameters.name: longVenue
parameters.description: Cross-exchange: the venue of the long perp.

parameters.name: longContract
parameters.description: Cross-exchange: the long perp's contract symbol. Optional, resolved as `contract` is.

parameters.name: shortVenue
parameters.description: Cross-exchange: the venue of the short perp.

parameters.name: shortContract
parameters.description: Cross-exchange: the short perp's contract symbol. Optional, resolved as `contract` is.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Backtest window in days (1-90): the series covers it, and `backtests` lists it after the shorter standard windows.

200.description: Spread series and backtests returned successfully.

get.description: Returns near-versus-far dated futures spreads (every adjacent pair, plus every pair of last-Friday monthly and quarterly contracts at least 7 days apart) using the buy leg ask and sell leg bid, with direction and curve from mark (else mid) prices. Pairs meeting the tenor floors (near leg at least 3 days out, legs at least 7 days apart) rank first; within them executable pairs that clear their fees, then such pairs executable on a live read (`snapshot_quote`), then the rest, each by signed post-fee net roll APY.

get.summary: Perp versus dated futures carry scanner
get.description: Returns perp-versus-dated carry rows: the dated contract's basis against the perp at the chosen trade's executable sides, against the funding the perp is expected to pay to expiry (the 7-day realised average; the current print under 3 days), with fee-adjusted annualized net carry used for filtering and ranking. Rows at least 3 days from expiry rank first; within them executable rows, then rows executable on a live read (`snapshot_quote`), then the rest. The perp and dated legs are often on different venues (`crossVenue`): separate accounts and collateral.

Returns spot-perpetual funding-capture rows with live funding, verified spot or margin availability, diagnostic basis, gross APR, and net APR after the venue's taker fees, the adverse entry basis and (where public) the borrow cost of a reverse carry. Executable rows (both legs priced, one instrument within 5%, fresh quotes, depth reported on both legs covering $10,000) rank first, then rows whose only gap is unproven depth (`no_spot_depth`: spot prices are last trades with no book, so this is every clean row today), then the other indicative rows.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Filter by exchange name, or "all" for all exchanges.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Filter by perpetual-leg direction: short for positive funding capture, long for negative funding capture.

parameters.name: minOiUsd
parameters.description: Minimum open interest in USD on the perpetual leg (`perpOpenInterestUsd`). Default 0 (no floor). A row whose open interest is unknown fails a positive floor, and so does a row on a venue left out of the API's open-interest totals (MEXC: `openInterestExcludedVenues` elsewhere), whose stored value is kept on the row.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page (1-1000), in board order. Omitted with no `cursor`: every row. On v1 a paged answer carries `pagination`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.cursor` (100 rows a page when `limit` is omitted).

get.description: A market briefing rendered as markdown: total market cap, 24h volume, BTC dominance and the Fear & Greed Index; the top 5 and bottom 3 narratives by 24h change as the API ranks them; the funding book's highest and lowest markets by 8h-equivalent rate among fresh markets with at least $1M of open interest, printed as APR with each venue's `rate_kind` (mostly the estimate of the next payment, not yet charged); and the whole-market funding estimated over the next 24 hours at current rates. `inputs` lists each read with the freshness of its answer; a read that fails leaves a gap in the report, not an error.

One coin's analysis rendered as markdown: its price-prediction score and signals (when the asset is in the prediction coverage list), the price with its as-of; its current funding on its 10 largest markets by open interest (8h-equivalent rate and APR, each labelled with its `rate_kind`: on most venues the estimate of the next payment, not yet charged) with the average and median across venues; the asset's open-interest total from the global board in USD notional, with its 1h/24h change beside the 24h price change (USD open interest moves with price); and the dollars its funding is estimated to move over the next 24 hours at current rates. `inputs` lists each read with the freshness of its answer; a read that fails leaves a gap in the report, not an error.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Coin ticker (`BTC`, `ETH`, `1000PEPE`), any case. The funding reads resolve it to its asset (PEPE brings its 1000PEPE and KPEPE contracts); the price prediction is matched in the coverage list by that asset, else by ticker, never by a guessed slug. The settlement read matches the ticker as written, and the report names the asset's other spellings it leaves out.

get.description: Returns a price correlation matrix for the requested coins over the specified period.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Lookback period for correlation calculation.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated asset ids: CoinGecko ids for crypto (e.g. bitcoin) and short ids for TradFi (e.g. sp500, gold). Maximum 10. If omitted, returns the default set. Ids no source recognises are listed in an optional `unresolved` array (partial success, as on the free route); a selection none of whose ids is recognised returns 404 resource_not_found naming them.

get.description: Returns ecosystem-level market data (Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Arbitrum, Base, etc.) including market cap, volume, TVL, and performance metrics.

parameters.name: ecosystem
parameters.description: Ecosystem to return detail for: the config id (e.g. bnb) or the URL slug (e.g. bnb-chain, ethereum, solana). An unknown value returns 400 invalid_parameter listing the valid values.

parameters.name: correlation
parameters.description: Set to "true" to include correlation data.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Timeframe for correlation data.

parameters.name: excludeNative
parameters.description: Set to "true" to exclude the native token from aggregated metrics.

get.description: Returns every distinct base coin in the current funding-rate book with a display name and a same-origin logo path, ordered by symbol. Feeds coin pickers without downloading the full funding book; name and logo_url are null when no metadata exists.
Returns perpetual funding rates across all supported exchanges. Supports current snapshots, accumulated rates over multiple windows, and per-coin historical rates.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of funding rate data to retrieve.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: The coin to return: a ticker (e.g. BTC), a lot or venue spelling (e.g. `1000PEPE`, `kPEPE`), or the full name (e.g. `bitcoin`, resolved to BTC). Case-insensitive, one coin per request. `coin` names an asset, not a base_coin string: every contract of that asset is returned whatever its base_coin spelling, so `PEPE` also returns the 1000PEPE and KPEPE lot contracts (read `lot_multiplier`), and a ticker two assets share (BB is BounceBit and BlackBerry) returns both, narrowed by `asset_class`. Optional filter for type=current and type=accumulated; required when type=history. A value that no perpetual in the funding book has ever settled returns 400 rather than an empty result set; GET /api/funding/coins lists every ticker carried.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of history to retrieve (type=history only).

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Filter to a single venue. Accepts the slug (e.g. `gate-io`), the display name as returned in the `exchange` field (e.g. `Gate.io`), or the ccxt id. The venue registry is not frozen, so read the `sharpe://exchanges` MCP resource or /api/funding/rates for the current list. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one underlying category. The funding book is not crypto-only. Tokenized equity, commodity, index and FX perps trade on the same venues, so this is unfiltered by default. Applies to type=current and type=accumulated; ignored for type=history. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one collateral convention: `linear` for quote-margined contracts, `inverse` for coin-margined ones. Unfiltered by default. Applies to type=current and type=accumulated; ignored for type=history. An unrecognized value returns 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: type=current only: order the rows by `open_interest`, ascending, or descending with the leading `-`. Rows with unknown open interest come last either way. Applied before `limit`/`cursor`. Default: the book's order (base_coin, exchange, symbol).

parameters.name: extremes
parameters.description: type=current only: answer with the N highest and N lowest rows by `rate_8h` (`extremes.highest`, `extremes.lowest`) among fresh rows with a usable interval, and how many rows each check left out (`extremes.omitted`). The other filters narrow the rows first. Returns an object instead of rows; cannot be combined with `limit`, `cursor` or `sort`.

parameters.name: min_oi_usd
parameters.description: type=current, with `extremes` only: leave out rows whose open interest in USD is below this floor. A row with unknown open interest fails a floor above 0.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: type=current only: `1` answers with the whole book's funding (`market`: mean and open-interest-weighted APR, and the count of positive and negative rates). Returns an object instead of rows; cannot be combined with `coin`, `exchange`, `margin`, `asset_class`, `limit`, `cursor` or `sort`.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: type=current, with `coin` only: `1` answers with the coin's funding across venues (`summary`: average and median 8-hour rate, how they were reduced, and the venues behind them). Returns an object instead of rows; cannot be combined with `limit`, `cursor` or `sort`.

get.description: Returns how many dollars actually changed hands at funding settlement, and which side paid it. fee_usd = open_interest_usd x rate, priced at the one-sided open interest (each contract counted once, the side that pays) recorded at or before each settlement. `current` is the next 24 hours at current rates (each contract's forward rate x 24 / its own interval hours), computed live; `1d`/`3d`/`7d` are realised windows from a materialized view. Every window reports both long_paid and short_paid alongside net, and the `totals` block reconciles crypto + rwa === all. Venues in settlementMeta.oi_excluded_venues are priced per venue (venues[].excluded_from_totals) but left out of every coin row and the totals.

200.description: Funding fee settlement data returned successfully.

get.description: Returns up to 1000 coins with futures data, including funding, open-interest, liquidation, long/short, CVD, and dated-basis capability flags plus observed venue coverage and market-cap rank.

Returns time-series data for a specific futures chart. Supports open interest (one-sided USD notional per venue), volume, funding rate history, liquidations, long/short ratios, basis, term structure, OHLCV, and more. A database read that fails before returning any row answers 503 (Retry-After) rather than an empty dataset; one that fails part-way returns the rows it has, with coverage.status "partial", coverage.warnings and an X-Data-Partial header. chart=cvd serves OHLCV candle rows with the CVD precomputed: each candle with a taker volume carries `cvd_delta_usd` ((2 * taker_buy_volume - volume) * close) and `cvd_usd`, the running sum per venue from the first candle in the window (Binance only today; coverage.warnings names the venues without one). The free route also joins open-interest overlay rows (open_interest_value, no close) into cvd to normalise CVD by open interest; tell the two apart by close. returns-session, returns-heatmap, returns-hour and returns-day serve the raw 1h candles of the highest-volume venue (the averages are computed by the client). Composite charts (perp-dislocation, funding-cost, crowding-risk, flow-confirmation, carry-curve) serve their raw input rows tagged with `_type`. Liquidation `quantity` is USD notional.

parameters.name: chart
parameters.description: Futures chart identifier.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Base coin ticker.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Lookback window for the data.

parameters.name: exchanges
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of exchanges to include (e.g. Binance,Bybit).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of data points per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

get.description: Returns up to 1,000 market-ranked token rows, optionally scoped to one chain with `chain`, with market cap, nullable FDV and FDV/MCap ratio, volume, nullable price and market-cap changes, circulating supply, ATH and ATL history, preferred chain scope, and observed exchange availability. Stablecoins, wrapped/bridged/pegged and liquid-staking derivative assets, tokenized stocks, assets whose upstream quote is more than 24 hours old (delisted or halted markets that would otherwise report a weeks-old price change as if it were current), and rows below minimum market-cap or volume thresholds are excluded. Ambiguous same-ticker assets do not receive symbol-only exchange attribution. Enrichment coverage is exposed in syncStatus. No wallet signal or proprietary token score is returned.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Keep only assets deployed on this chain. A multi-chain asset matches every chain in its chainSlugs, not only its preferred chainSlug; a native L1 coin with no token contract on a supported chain (BTC, ETH) matches none. An unknown chain is a 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens to return per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque, snapshot-bound pagination cursor from a previous response. Cursors expire when the cache refreshes; restart without a cursor after an expiry error.

200.description: Gem finder data returned successfully. Returns a paginated envelope when the `limit` query parameter is supplied, otherwise the full dataset in a success envelope.

get.description: Whole-market derivatives board. Returns market-wide metrics (total open interest -- one-sided USD notional, each contract counted once, summed over every venue except metrics.openInterestExcludedVenues -- with its crypto-versus-RWA split, 24h liquidations, average Wilder RSI(14) across the top 100 crypto perps by market cap, the Altcoin Season Index, and open interest by asset class) plus a ranked per-asset row table for the requested tab. Liquidations are crypto-only: no RWA perp venue publishes a liquidation feed. Market cap is absent on the preipo and index tabs. When composing the board fails or runs past its 20-second budget, the crypto tab answers from the last composed snapshot with X-Data-Stale true and X-Data-As-Of set to that snapshot's own time, not cached; other tabs answer the last board the server composed for the tab, flagged the same way, when it has one, and 503 (Retry-After: 30) otherwise. A tab with no rows returns 503.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Universe to return rows for. The metric block is identical on every tab.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows per page (1-1000). Enables cursor pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

get.description: Returns database reachability and News article freshness. The service is degraded when the database is unavailable or the newest News article is stale or has unknown freshness. It also lists per-dataset freshness (`datasets`) read from the snapshot index and the cache rows; a stale dataset does not make the service degraded. No authentication required.

Returns heatmap data for coins, narratives, or ecosystems. Aggregate modes expose complete or partial category coverage. The legacy top-100 category slug returns the current Top 50 universe. The cache is rebuilt every two hours; X-Data-Stale is true once updated_at is more than four hours old (X-Freshness-Sla-Seconds 14400) or missing, and X-Data-As-Of repeats updated_at.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Heatmap grouping mode.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One of 36 category slugs (e.g. top-100, defi, layer-1). The legacy top-100 slug returns the Top 50 universe.

get.description: Composite score (0-10) flagging coins with persistent negative funding rates across the perpetual futures venues Sharpe reads funding from (`exchange_count` is how many carry the coin). Higher scores indicate stronger evidence of systematic short positioning. Updates every 30 minutes. Units: `oi_change_24h` is a fraction (0.07 = +7%) of USD-notional open interest over 24 h on the venues read at both ends, so a price move alone moves it; `price_change_24h` / `price_change_7d` are percent (5.4 = +5.4%) read from the market tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the 30-minute scoring run; `holders_change_pct`, `liquidity_change_pct` and `volume_change_pct` are fractions between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart), null on a run with no newer snapshot. Basis and CVD exist only for the futures-covered majors, so most altcoin rows carry them null. A `coin` answer is dated by that coin's own row (`updated_at`): a coin that stopped qualifying keeps the inputs of its last qualifying run and reads stale.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of coins to return.

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: Filter to coins scoring at or above this value.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: One coin by its CoinGecko id (e.g. pepe): its row exactly as the scorer wrote it, whatever its score, and the answer is dated by that row's own `updated_at`. A coin that stopped qualifying answers `score: null` with its sub-scores and phase cleared, keeps the other inputs of its last qualifying run, and reads stale with a warning; an id with no row answers an empty list. `limit`, `min_score` and `phase` do not apply.

X-Sharpe-Data-State.description: Freshness state using the 1-hour market-manipulation SLA.

get.description: Returns aggregated weekly and monthly compatibility listing counts plus the last-90-day recent listings for the New Listings product. Optionally filter by narrative slug or exchange. Counts and `recent` include only resolved spot listings (status `active`: a CoinGecko id and a mapped narrative); brand-new tokens still awaiting resolution (`needs_review`/`uncategorized`) are left out, so the newest listings are undercounted. Every observed listing, perps included, is in the canonical event feed at `/v1/listings/events`; enabled listing connectors refresh hourly.

parameters.name: narrative
parameters.description: Filter to a single narrative slug (e.g. `ai-agents`, `memes`, `layer-1`).

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Filter to a single exchange.

get.description: Returns canonical listing lifecycle events across CEXs and Perp DEXs, including Spot listings, Perp listings, delistings, suspensions, resumptions, scheduled trading starts, source URLs, source confidence, source-observation freshness, and per-provider health. The opaque cursor advances the persisted database and official live-overlay streams independently so either source can fill a page without stranding the other.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Filter to a single exchange or perp DEX.

parameters.name: venue_type
parameters.description: Filter by venue type.

parameters.name: market_type
parameters.description: Filter by market type.

parameters.name: event_type
parameters.description: Filter by listing lifecycle event type.

parameters.name: asset_class
parameters.description: Filter by listed instrument class.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by event status.

parameters.name: narrative
parameters.description: Filter by Sharpe narrative slug.

parameters.name: confidence
parameters.description: Filter by source confidence.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO date or datetime lower bound.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO date or datetime upper bound.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window in days.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows returned.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque two-stream cursor returned by the previous page. Pass it through unchanged.

get.description: Returns the typed listing connector registry, including supported market types, source URLs, parser confidence, connector status, and market coverage for each exchange.

parameters.name: venue_type
parameters.description: Filter exchange coverage by venue type.

parameters.name: market_type
parameters.description: Filter exchange coverage by supported market type.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Filter to enabled or disabled connectors.

get.description: Returns a flat list of recent listings (token, exchange, narrative, listing date). Defaults remain backward-compatible with the legacy spot feed; event-specific filters switch to the canonical event feed while preserving the recent-feed row shape. The legacy feed (no event filter, no `from`/`to`/`cursor`, and `exchange` unset or one of binance, okx, bybit, gateio, mexc) holds only resolved spot listings (status `active`: a CoinGecko id and a mapped narrative), so brand-new tokens awaiting resolution and perps are missing; it has no `next_cursor`, so `limit` truncates it. warnings.description: What the read could not do, in words (an unreadable table, a late writer).

truncated.description: True when a row budget cut the answer short.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response following RFC 9457 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs).

pegQuality.description: `measured` when 24h volume is at least $10K and the price at most 6 h old; otherwise `indicative` (an illiquid or stale print, shown and ranked after the measured deviations). Null when there is no deviation.

volume24hUsd.description: Trailing 24h trading volume in USD over the venues CoinGecko tracks; null when CoinGecko does not list the coin.

priceUpdatedAt.description: Newest time the price can be vouched for (ISO 8601); null when neither CoinGecko's quote time nor the DeFi Llama snapshot stamp is known.

circulating.description: USD value, not a token count: circulating units translated to USD at the peg's FX rate, the same number as nominalSupplyValue (equal to the unit count only for USD pegs; a EUR or gold peg reads its supply times the EUR or gold rate). Divide by the peg rate for units.

dailyNetIssuance90d.description: Daily net issuance in USD per UTC day (`t`, unix seconds), like for like: the day's change in supply at peg less any stablecoin DeFi Llama starts or stops charting that day. Differencing `history90d` counts those coins as mints and redemptions.

updatedAt.description: Oldest contributing component timestamp; retained components prevent partial refreshes from advancing it.

as_of.description: Oldest contributing component timestamp for the served snapshot.

circulating.description: USD value of the stablecoin's supply on this chain (units translated at the peg's FX rate), not a token count.

pegQuality.description: `measured` when 24h volume is at least $10K and the price at most 6 h old; otherwise `indicative` (an illiquid or stale print, shown and ranked after the measured deviations). Null when there is no deviation.

volume24hUsd.description: Trailing 24h trading volume in USD over the venues CoinGecko tracks; null when CoinGecko does not list the coin.

priceUpdatedAt.description: Newest time the price can be vouched for (ISO 8601); null when neither CoinGecko's quote time nor the DeFi Llama snapshot stamp is known.

circulating.description: USD value, not a token count: circulating units translated to USD at the peg's FX rate, the same number as nominalSupplyValue (equal to the unit count only for USD pegs; a EUR or gold peg reads its supply times the EUR or gold rate). Divide by the peg rate for units.

hourlyRate.description: Interest per hour on the borrowed amount, a fraction (0.0000049 = 0.00049% an hour). A venue that publishes a daily rate is divided by 24.

annualRate.description: hourlyRate × 8,760, simple (not compounded), a fraction (0.043 = 4.3% a year).

source.description: The L0 endpoint contract the rate came from (bybit.spot-margin-data, okx.interest-rate-loan-quota, binance.margin-vip-spec, gate.unified-history-loan-rate).

asOf.description: When the venue stamped the rate (Bybit's server time, Gate's rate hour), else when Sharpe fetched it (OKX, Binance).

rates.description: One quote per venue that prices the coin, cheapest first. A venue that does not price the coin is absent, never 0.

status.description: ok: fresh (≤ 5 minutes). stale: the last refresh failed and the last good answer (≤ 15 minutes old) is served. failed: nothing usable, the venue's coins are absent. unsupported: the venue publishes no keyless borrow rate.

venuesAnswering.description: Selected venues that returned at least one order book and one transfer network.

status.description: not_live: the venue's public spot ticker shows no live book (left out of coverage); failed/no_books/no_networks make the answer degraded.

routesEvaluated.description: Directed (coin, buy venue, sell venue) routes with a computed net: both books fill the notional on one common open network.

routesProfitable.description: Evaluated routes netting above zero after fees.

bestNetPct.description: Best net profit over evaluated routes, percent of the notional; null when none was evaluated.

stale.description: True when `updatedAt` is older than `freshnessSlaSeconds`. Each row carries its own `isStale` by the same threshold.

freshnessSlaSeconds.description: Seconds a row's snapshot stays fresh: 7,200 on the dated basis, calendar and carry boards (the term-structure SLA; the envelope's `freshness_sla_seconds` is 7,200 when the hourly term structure answered and 600 when the 5-minute dated-quotes snapshot did, its `dataset_id` says which), 60 on the CEX transfer board (its order books, the envelope's `freshness_sla_seconds`; transfer networks are judged on 10 minutes per row).

source.description: Where the board's rows came from: the stored hourly term-structure snapshot, a stored snapshot past its SLA, the venues read live (on request, or by the 5-minute dated-quotes snapshot the arbitrage-boards cron writes: then the envelope's `dataset_id` is `arbitrage_dated_quotes` and `served_from` is `snapshot`; always `live` on the CEX transfer board), or nothing. The upstream source ids are in the X-Data-Source header.

supportedCoins.description: The coins the board covers: the supported basis coins on the dated boards; the coins the scan fetched on the CEX transfer board.

transferEta.description: Deprecated: `transferConfirmations` as a label ("15 confs"), not a time.

transferConfirmations.description: Deposit confirmations the sell venue waits for on the route's network; null when it does not report them.

netProfitPct.description: [VWAP_sell(q - withdrawFee) x (1 - sellTakerFee) - N x (1 + buyTakerFee)] / N, percent of the notional N. At or below zero on near-miss rows (`indicativeReason: below_fees`).

buyTakerFeePct.description: Spot taker fee charged on the buy fill: the venue catalog's own when it reports one, else the shared venue fee table.

spreadLifetimeSeconds.description: How long this server instance has seen the route continuously; resets on a cold start or another instance.

updatedAt.description: The older of the two order books (quote time).

networkUpdatedAt.description: The older of the two venues' transfer-network reads.

isStale.description: An order book older than the 60 s quote SLA, or a transfer-network read older than 10 minutes.

executionStatus.description: Executable: fresh books and networks, both books fill the notional, net profit above zero.

assetClass.description: Underlying category from the funding book: `crypto`, `equity`, `commodity`, `fx` or `index`. A pair's two legs always share it.

netApr.description: `apr` − (2 perpetual taker fills on each venue at its standard fee + the adverse entry spread) × 365 / 30, a decimal fraction per year. A favourable (negative) spread is never credited. Only on a book-priced spread whose legs are within 20% of each other; else `null`.

spreadRate.description: The entry price gap between the legs, not a funding spread: (long-leg ask − short-leg bid) ÷ their midpoint, a fraction (from last or mark prices when a book is missing, see `spreadSource`). Positive costs the trade on entry, negative is favourable. The funding spread is `netFundingRate`.

spreadSource.description: Where `spreadRate` comes from: `book` (both legs' order books), `reference` (last or mark prices), or `null` when either leg has no price.

longAsk.description: Best ask on the long venue, per asset unit (the contract's price ÷ its lot multiplier: a 1000PEPE contract's ask ÷ 1000).

shortBid.description: Best bid on the short venue, per asset unit.

executableDepthUsd.description: Top-of-book depth in USD the entry can fill: the smallest of the long venue's ask size and the short venue's bid size among the legs that report one. When only one venue reports depth it is that leg's figure, an upper bound, and the row is `indicative` (`no_depth`, or `thin_book` when it is under $10,000); `null` when neither venue reports depth (`no_depth`).

executionStatus.description: Whether the row can be traded on the figures shown. "executable" needs a book-priced spread (spreadSource "book"), leg prices within 5% of each other, both quotes within the board's 10-minute SLA at the time of the request, no leg reporting open interest under $10,000, and top-of-book depth REPORTED by both venues and at least $10,000 (unknown depth is not evidence of a fill). Anything else is "indicative" with `indicativeReason`; past a 20% gap the legs read as two instruments and `netApr` is null. Indicative rows keep every figure and sort below executable ones: first those whose only gap is unreported depth (`no_depth`), then the rest.

volumeLong24hUsd.description: 24h perp turnover in USD on the long venue; `null` when the venue does not report it.

volumeShort24hUsd.description: 24h perp turnover in USD on the short venue; `null` when the venue does not report it.

pairStatus.description: Whether the two legs are one instrument: `eligible`, `unpriced` when a leg has no price to check, else the first check that failed; `price_gap` means the legs' prices are more than 20% apart.

fundingAsOf.description: When the older leg's funding rate was written; `null` when either is unknown.

pricesAsOf.description: When the older of the two legs' quotes behind the spread and depth was read; `null` when neither leg has a quote.

indicativeReason.description: Why the row is `indicative`; `null` when executable. `reference_only`: no book on a leg (spread from last or mark prices); `price_gap`: legs 5-20% apart (net APR kept) or past 20% (none); `thin_book`: reported top-of-book depth under $10,000; `oi_below_notional`: a leg reports open interest under $10,000 (unknown open interest is no evidence either way); `stale_quote`: a quote older than the board's 10-minute SLA; `no_depth`: every other check passes but a venue reports no top-of-book size, so the fill is unproven (ranks right after the executable rows).

roundTripFeeRate.description: Two perpetual taker fills on each venue at its standard (VIP 0) fee, a decimal fraction of notional.

breakEvenDays.description: Days of carry that pay back the one-time costs: (fees + adverse entry spread) ÷ (`apr` / 365). `null` without a `netApr`.

longSymbol.description: The long venue's own contract symbol (e.g. `1000PEPEUSDT`, `kPEPE`): legs of one asset pair across lot sizes.

shortSymbol.description: The short venue's own contract symbol.

longIntervalHours.description: The long leg's own funding interval in hours: `longRate` is per this many hours (`intervalHours` is the faster of the two legs).

shortIntervalHours.description: The short leg's own funding interval in hours: `shortRate` is per this many hours.

longPricesAsOf.description: When the long venue's quote was read; `null` without one.

shortPricesAsOf.description: When the short venue's quote was read; `null` without one.

executionStatus.description: Whether the row can be traded at the requested notional on the figures shown. "executable" needs all of: a snapshot inside the freshness SLA; book depth behind the spot ask and futures bid of at least notional (level 1 on a stored snapshot row, `depth_beyond_top_of_book` when thinner; on a live read a side thinner at level 1 than the default notional is walked 20 levels deep and priced at that walk's VWAP); no reported open interest on the contract below notional (unknown open interest does not demote); 24h volume of at least notional; a non-negative basis; and quotes at most 10 minutes old (a live read, not the hourly snapshot). Otherwise "indicative" with `indicativeReason`: every figure is kept. Indicative rows sort below executable ones.

indicativeReason.description: Why the row is indicative, the first failing check in this order: `stale_snapshot` (past the term-structure SLA), `no_perp_book` (carry: the perp has no bid/ask for its own contract), `no_depth`, `depth_below_notional` (the top-20 book walked is thinner than the notional), `depth_beyond_top_of_book` (the depth known is level 1 only and thinner than the notional: the rest would fill beyond the quote the row is priced at), `oi_below_notional`, `no_volume` (no 24h volume, or less than the notional), `backwardation_needs_borrow` (basis: a negative basis, and calendar: a backwardated Sell Near / Buy Far lock-in; the reverse trade needs a spot borrow the board does not price), `snapshot_quote` (every other check passes but the quotes are older than 10 minutes: executable on a live read). Null when executable. Absent on answers before 2026-09-30.

nearExpiry.description: Under 3 days to expiry: the round-trip fee annualized over the days left dominates the APR. Served, ranked after every row at least 3 days out. Absent on answers before 2026-09-30.

feesPct.description: Round-trip fees: 2 spot and 2 dated-futures taker fills at the venue's standard fee (engine/derive/venue-fees.ts), percent, not annualized.

FuturesBasisAggregate.description: Per-coin summary over the ranked contracts at least three days from expiry (one day until 2026-09-30). Contracts closer to expiry stay in rows but are left out, because a round-trip fee annualized over a few days dominates the APR; a coin with no qualifying contract has no entry.

raw.description: Provider-native pool payload when retained for diagnostics.

spreadPct.description: Gross discovery spread before transfer costs, fees, and slippage.

marketId.description: Boros market id (the key: one venue contract can list twice on different collateral).

venue.description: The venue whose perp funding the market settles against, as Boros names it (Binance, OKX, Hyperliquid, Gate, Kucoin, Lighter, Bybit).

fundingExchange.description: Our funding store's exchange for the matched contract (Gate.io, KuCoin, tradeXYZ for Hyperliquid's xyz dex); null when not covered.

fundingContract.description: The matched perp's native symbol as /v1/funding/rates serves it (BTCUSDT, BTC-USDT-SWAP, XBTUSDTM, BTC-USD, xyz:BRENTOIL); null when not covered.

collateral.description: Boros collateral token (BTC, ETH, USDT, HYPE, BNB).

daysToMaturity.description: Fractional days from the answer's generation to maturity.

settlementIntervalHours.description: The underlying perp's settlement interval, hours (Boros paymentPeriod).

impliedApr.description: Boros implied (fixed) APR: the market's mark (fair-value) rate.

bestBidApr.description: Best bid APR: the fixed rate a seller of yield (receive fixed, pay floating) gets now.

floatingApr.description: The underlying (floating) APR as Boros reports it: the venue's current funding annualised by Boros's oracle.

realised7dApr.description: Our realised funding for the same venue contract over the last 7 days, annualised: acc_7d × 365 / 7 (funding_accumulated).

realised7dNullReason.description: Why the realised figure is null (never 0): venue_not_covered (Boros quotes a venue or Hyperliquid builder dex our funding store does not track), contract_not_in_store (no accumulated funding row for the contract), store_unavailable (the funding store could not be read), accumulated_stale (the 7/30-day sums are past their freshness SLA), listed_within_window (the contract's first stored settlement is inside the window), history_stale (its last stored settlement is over a day old).

realised30dApr.description: Realised funding over the last 30 days, annualised: acc_30d × 365 / 30.

realised30dNullReason.description: Why the realised figure is null (never 0): venue_not_covered (Boros quotes a venue or Hyperliquid builder dex our funding store does not track), contract_not_in_store (no accumulated funding row for the contract), store_unavailable (the funding store could not be read), accumulated_stale (the 7/30-day sums are past their freshness SLA), listed_within_window (the contract's first stored settlement is inside the window), history_stale (its last stored settlement is over a day old).

spread7dApr.description: impliedApr − realised7dApr. Positive: locking the fixed rate beats what the floating leg paid over 7 days. Gross: no Boros or venue fees.

spread30dApr.description: impliedApr − realised30dApr (the rank key). Gross: no Boros or venue fees.

openInterestUsd.description: Boros open interest, one side: notionalOI (yield units of the collateral token) × the collateral's USD price.

borosAsOf.description: Block time of the Boros indexer head the market was read at.

fundingAsOf.description: When the funding_accumulated view behind the realised figures was refreshed; null when not covered.

unmatched.description: Markets without a realised 7-day figure, by realised7dNullReason.

role.description: `perp` on a spot-perp pair (its side is `direction`); `long` and `short` on a cross-exchange pair.

contract.description: The venue's native contract symbol the settlements are read for.

contractSource.description: `given`: the query named the contract. `resolved`: the venue's contract for the coin with the largest current open interest (unknown open interest last), then the most settlements in the window, the latest settlement, the symbol.

side.description: The position on this perp: a short leg receives positive funding, a long leg pays it.

intervalHours.description: The interval of the leg's latest settlement, in hours, read from the gap to the settlement before it (else the stored interval); null when none was readable. Never assumed 8.

settlements.description: Settlements read for the leg (the window plus a 2-day margin).

takerFee.description: The venue's standard perp taker fee per fill (src/engine/derive/venue-fees.ts).

at.description: A settlement instant of either leg.

spreadApr.description: The position's funding spread at `at`, annualized simply: Σ over the legs of ±(rate × 8,760 / interval hours), + for a short leg, − for a long leg. Each leg is read at the settlement whose interval covers `at` (legs aligned by time, never by index); null when a leg has no covering settlement (a gap, or its interval has not settled yet).

legAprs.description: Each leg's own funding at `at`, annualized (rate × 8,760 / interval hours, the venue's sign), in `legs` order; null where the leg is uncovered.

cashflow.description: Funding the position received at `at` (fraction of one leg's notional, negative when paid): the settlements of the legs that settle at this instant.

cumulativeCarry.description: Running sum of `cashflow` from the start of the requested window's backtest; fees are not included.

estimated.description: True when a leg is read at an estimated settlement at `at`: the funding cron's last pre-settlement rate (stored `source: inferred`), not yet replaced by the venue's own record by the reconcile job. Its `legAprs`, `spreadApr` and `cashflow` can still change. False for venue-recorded settlements and for rows stored before provenance was tracked (2026-09-26).

days.description: The window held: the last `days` days to `end`.

start.description: Where the backtest starts: `end` − `days`, or later when a leg's history begins inside the window.

end.description: The latest instant every leg's funding is realised: the earliest of the legs' last settlements (`windowEnd`).

coveredDays.description: Days from `start` to `end`: the span the figures cover and annualize over.

complete.description: Every leg has history from the window's start and its settlements price at least 90% of the covered span. Coverage only: it does not say the settlements are final; see `estimatedSettlements`.

coverageRatio.description: The least-covered leg's share of the covered span its settlements price (Σ settlement interval ÷ span, at most 1). Missing settlements lower it; they are never read as zero funding.

estimatedSettlements.description: Settlements in (start, end], over all legs, that are the funding cron's pre-settlement estimates rather than the venue's record (series points marked `estimated`). Above 0, `fundingCollected` and the figures built on it can still move once those settlements are reconciled.

fundingCollected.description: Sum of the position's funding settlements in (start, end], fraction of one leg's notional; funding is paid at the settlement instant, so a settlement counts in full.

fees.description: Entry and exit taker fees, fraction of one leg's notional: 2 spot + 2 perp fills on the venue (spot-perp), 2 fills on each perp (cross-exchange). Same as `roundTripFees`.

netApr.description: `netReturn × 365 / coveredDays`: fees are charged once, so short windows carry them heavily.

negativeCarryDays.description: 24-hour periods, counted back from `end` (not UTC days), whose settlements summed below zero.

daysObserved.description: Full 24-hour periods inside the covered span that held at least one settlement.

maxDrawdown.description: Largest fall of cumulative funding from its running peak (starting at 0 at `start`), fraction of one leg's notional; fees excluded.

breakEvenDays.description: `fees` ÷ the realised average daily funding; null unless funding was positive.

direction.description: Spot-perp only: `short` = buy spot, short the perp (collects positive funding); `long` = sell spot, long the perp. Null on cross-exchange.

spot.description: Spot-perp only: the spot leg (same venue; spot pays no funding) and its taker fee per fill.

requiresBorrow.description: True for a spot-perp `long` direction: the coin must be borrowed on margin to sell spot.

borrowCostIncluded.description: Always false: margin borrow interest is not in the backtest.

windowEnd.description: Every backtest's `end`; null when a leg has no usable settlement.

series.description: The spread at every settlement instant of either leg over the requested window's backtest span, ascending.

backtests.description: One per window: 1, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days where shorter than `days`, then `days` itself, ascending.

nearBasisPct.description: The near contract's reference price (mark, else book mid; never the last trade since 2026-09-30) against the venue's spot reference, percent.

farBasisPct.description: The far contract's reference price against the same spot reference, percent.

forwardYieldPct.description: Executable forward APR: (sell leg bid / buy leg ask − 1) × 365 / gapDays, percent, the legs chosen by `direction`.

direction.description: From the reference prices (mark, else mid): the far contract above the near one buys near and sells far.

netRollApyPct.description: Lock-in net APR: (executable spread − feesPct / 100) × 365 / gapDays × 100. May be negative.

executionStatus.description: Whether the row can be traded at the requested notional on the figures shown. "executable" needs all of: both snapshots inside the freshness SLA; book depth behind both legs of at least notional (level 1 on a stored snapshot row, `depth_beyond_top_of_book` when thinner; on a live read a side thinner at level 1 than the default notional is walked 20 levels deep and priced at that walk's VWAP); a contango pair (a backwardated Sell Near / Buy Far lock-in needs a spot borrow: `backwardation_needs_borrow`); no reported open interest on the smaller leg below notional (unknown open interest does not demote); 24h volume on the thinner leg of at least notional; and quotes at most 10 minutes old (a live read). Otherwise "indicative" with `indicativeReason`: every figure is kept.

indicativeReason.description: Why the row is indicative, the first failing check in this order: `stale_snapshot` (past the term-structure SLA), `no_perp_book` (carry: the perp has no bid/ask for its own contract), `no_depth`, `depth_below_notional` (the top-20 book walked is thinner than the notional), `depth_beyond_top_of_book` (the depth known is level 1 only and thinner than the notional: the rest would fill beyond the quote the row is priced at), `oi_below_notional`, `no_volume` (no 24h volume, or less than the notional), `backwardation_needs_borrow` (basis: a negative basis, and calendar: a backwardated Sell Near / Buy Far lock-in; the reverse trade needs a spot borrow the board does not price), `snapshot_quote` (every other check passes but the quotes are older than 10 minutes: executable on a live read). Null when executable. Absent on answers before 2026-09-30.

nearDays.description: Fractional days from the request to the near expiry.

gapDays.description: Fractional days between the two expiries: the annualization denominator.

belowTenorFloor.description: The near leg is under 3 days from expiry or the legs expire under 7 days apart: served, ranked after every pair meeting both floors.

referenceForwardYieldPct.description: Reference forward APR, (F_far / F_near − 1) × 365 / gapDays on mark (else mid) prices, percent: it sets `curve` and `direction`.

priceReference.description: What the reference prices are: `mark` when the venue reported a mark price for both legs, else `mid` (book mid on at least one leg).

feesPct.description: Lock-in round-trip fees: 4 dated-futures and 2 spot taker fills at the venue's standard fees, percent, not annualized.

perpFundingAprPct.description: The perp's current funding print annualized (rate × 8,760 / interval), percent. Same number as `currentFundingAprPct`.

expectedFundingToExpiryPct.description: Funding the perp is expected to pay to expiry, percent: the projected rate (`fundingProjection`) per settlement × `fundingSettlementsToExpiry` (was the current print × days / 365 until 2026-09-30).

datedBasisPct.description: The dated contract's basis against the PERP at the chosen trade's executable sides, percent: (F_bid / P_ask − 1) when shorting the dated leg, (F_ask / P_bid − 1) when buying it; on mark/last prices when the perp has no book (against spot until 2026-09-30).

carryEdgePct.description: `expectedFundingToExpiryPct − datedBasisPct`, percent: positive when collecting funding on a short perp beats the basis paid on the long dated leg.

netCarryEdgePct.description: The chosen trade's edge to expiry less `feesPct`: `carryEdgePct − feesPct` for Perp Carry, `−carryEdgePct − feesPct` for Dated Cash-and-Carry. May be negative.

grossCarryAprPct.description: The chosen trade's edge before fees, annualized over `days`. May be negative when the book spread exceeds the edge.

bestLeg.description: The trade with the larger edge: Perp Carry = short perp / long dated (collect funding), Dated Cash-and-Carry = long perp / short dated (keep the basis).

funding7dStabilityPct.description: Deprecated alias of `funding7dCumulativePct`: the 7-day cumulative funding, not a stability measure.

executableDepthUsd.description: The smaller book depth on the two sides the trade hits: the dated contract's and the perp's own contract. Null when either is unknown (a perp with no book).

oiDepthUsd.description: Legacy compatibility metric. Use executableDepthUsd and minOpenInterestUsd.

executionStatus.description: Whether the row can be traded at the requested notional on the figures shown. "executable" needs all of: both legs inside the freshness SLA; a book for the perp's own contract; depth on the dated side and the perp side the trade hits of at least notional (the perp's ticker level 1, and the dated side's level 1 on a stored snapshot row: `depth_beyond_top_of_book` when thinner; on a live read a thin dated side is walked 20 levels deep and priced at that walk's VWAP); no reported open interest on the smaller leg below notional (unknown open interest does not demote); the dated contract's 24h volume of at least notional; and every quote at most 10 minutes old. Null when executable. Absent on answers before 2026-09-30.

direction.description: The trade the row prices, the same choice as `bestLeg`: which leg is shorted.

crossVenue.description: The perp and the dated contract trade on different venues: two accounts, each collateralized separately; the board does not price the transfer between them.

nearExpiry.description: Under 3 days to expiry: served, ranked after every row at least 3 days out; the projection then uses the current print.

currentFundingAprPct.description: The current funding print annualized (rate × 8,760 / interval), percent.

funding7dAprPct.description: The 7-day realised funding annualized (acc_7d × 365 / 7), percent; null when the 7-day sum is unknown or the matview is past its freshness SLA.

fundingProjection.description: The rate `expectedFundingToExpiryPct` projects: the 7-day realised average, or the current print (under 3 days to expiry, or no current 7-day sum).

fundingIntervalHours.description: The perp's settlement interval in hours (1, 2, 4, 8, …): the current print is per this many hours.

fundingSettlementsToExpiry.description: Funding settlements between the request and expiry on the perp's own grid (a settlement at the expiry instant counts).

datedLegPrice.description: The dated price the basis uses: its bid when shorting it, its ask when buying it (mark or mid without a book).

perpLegPrice.description: The perp price the basis uses: its ask when buying it, its bid when shorting it; null when the perp has no book.

feesPct.description: Round-trip fees: 2 perp and 2 dated-futures taker fills at each venue's standard fee, percent, not annualized.

updatedAt.description: The oldest input the row is priced on: the dated snapshot, the funding row, the perp quote.

fundingRate.description: Funding rate as a decimal fraction per settlement interval.

apr.description: Annualized funding return as a decimal fraction (0.30 = 30%).

basisRate.description: Spot/perpetual basis as a decimal fraction (0.001 = 0.1%).

netApr.description: Annualized return after one-time costs, a decimal fraction (0.30 = 30%): `apr` − (2 spot + 2 perp taker fills at the venue's fee + the adverse entry basis at the quoted sides) × 365 / 30 − the base coin's borrow APR on a sell-spot row when it is known. A favourable entry basis is never credited. Null when a leg is unpriced (`pairStatus` `unpriced`) or the spot and perp prices are more than 20% apart (larger / smaller − 1 > 0.20: two instruments under one ticker).

perpSymbol.description: The venue's perpetual contract the row trades (its own symbol, e.g. `1000PEPEUSDT`).

perpOpenInterestUsd.description: One-sided open interest of that perpetual in USD: the venue ticker's figure, else the latest stored open interest of the contract (at most ~10 minutes old). `null` when neither is known, never 0.

fundingIsStale.description: `true` when `fundingAsOf` is older than the funding book's 10-minute freshness SLA at the time of the request.

executionStatus.description: `executable` when both legs are priced, they are one instrument within 5% of each other (the spot price against the perp's index, else mark, else last price, per asset unit), a sell-spot row's borrow rate is known and in `netApr`, both quotes are within the board's 10-minute SLA at the time of the request, and top-of-book depth on both legs is reported and covers $10,000; `indicative` otherwise, with `indicativeReason`: its figures stand, but it is not a verified trade. The board reads spot prices as last trades with no book, so no row is executable today: a row that passes every other check is `no_spot_depth`.

pairStatus.description: Whether the spot and perpetual legs are one instrument: `eligible`, `unpriced` when either leg has no price to check, else the first check that failed: `identity_mismatch` (the instrument master places the legs on different assets), `price_gap` (prices more than 20% apart).

fundingAsOf.description: When the funding rate behind the row was written; `null` when unknown.

pricesAsOf.description: When the older of the spot and perpetual prices behind `basisRate` was read; `null` when the row has neither price.

indicativeReason.description: Why the row is `indicative`; `null` when executable. `price_gap`: the legs are 5-20% apart (a net APR is still computed) or more than 20% (none); `stale_quote`: a leg's quote is older than the board's 10-minute SLA at the time of the request; `borrow_unpriced`: a sell-spot / long-perp row whose borrow rate the venue does not publish (`netApr` excludes that interest, so the row ranks after executable rows); `thin_book`: the perp's top-of-book depth on the side the trade hits is under $10,000; `oi_below_notional`: the perp reports open interest under $10,000; `no_spot_depth`: every other check passes but the spot leg is a last trade with no book behind it, so the fill is unproven (these rows rank right after the executable ones); `no_depth`: likewise for a perp leg that reports no size.

entryBasisRate.description: The entry basis at the quoted sides, positive when favourable: buy spot / short perp (perp bid − spot) / spot; sell spot / long perp (spot − perp ask) / perp ask. Spot is the venue's last trade; perp prices per asset unit. Only a negative value is charged in `netApr`.

roundTripFeeRate.description: Two spot and two perpetual taker fills at the venue's standard (VIP 0) fee, a decimal fraction of notional.

breakEvenDays.description: Days of carry that pay back the one-time costs: (fees + adverse entry basis) ÷ ((`apr` − `borrowApr`) / 365). `null` without a `netApr`.

requiresBorrow.description: `true` on a sell-spot / long-perp row: the base coin must be borrowed on margin.

borrowCostIncluded.description: `true` when the borrow interest is subtracted from `netApr` (the venue publishes the rate); `false` when the row needs a borrow whose rate is unknown (`netApr` then overstates the carry by that interest, and the row is `indicative` `borrow_unpriced`), and on rows that need none.

borrowApr.description: The borrow interest subtracted from `netApr`, a decimal fraction per year; `null` when none is.

apr7d.description: What the last 7 days of settlements paid this row's direction, annualized: `cumRate7d` × 365 / 7, sign flipped for a long-perp row. Negative when the 7-day carry ran against the direction; `null` without `cumRate7d`.

carrySignFlip7d.description: `true` when `apr7d` is negative: the current rate's direction lost money over the last 7 days. The board still ranks on the current rate.

perpLotMultiplier.description: Asset units per perpetual contract unit (1000 for `1000PEPEUSDT`, whose row `symbol` is PEPE); `null` when the instrument master does not know the contract.

spotPriceAsOf.description: When the spot price was read; `null` without one.

perpPriceAsOf.description: When the venue's perpetual ticker was read; `null` without a perp price.

status.description: `partial` when at least one category fetch failed in the last sync.

totalEcosystemExposureMcap.description: Sum of the ecosystems' market caps, each token counted in its home ecosystem only: the denominator of `dominance`.

marketCapMethod.description: How `totalEcosystemMcap` and the rows' `marketCap` are computed. `home-chain-constituents` (since 2026-09-30): a token CoinGecko files under several ecosystems counts only in its home ecosystem (its native chain, else CoinGecko's primary asset platform). `deduplicated-fetched-coins`: the earlier method, where a multichain token counted in full in every ecosystem that listed it.

dominanceMethod.description: `share-of-home-chain-market-caps` after a complete sync (`share-of-overlapping-ecosystem-exposures` before 2026-09-30). A sync that kept the previous rows repeats the previous method.

rate.description: Funding rate as a decimal fraction per `interval_hours`, as the venue publishes it. What it measures depends on the venue (`rate_kind`): on most venues the in-progress estimate for the settlement at `next_funding_time` (it moves until then and can differ from what the venue last charged by a multiple, or in sign); on Kraken, Crypto.com and Bitfinex the rate charged at the last settlement (`next_funding_time − interval_hours`); on Deribit the funding realised over the trailing 8 hours. The settled series is `type=history`.

predicted_rate.description: The venue's own forecast for the coming settlement, when it publishes one beside `rate`: Kraken (`fundingRatePrediction`), Crypto.com (`estimated_funding_rate`, an estimate for the next 4-hour interval rather than the next hourly settlement), Pacifica (`next_funding_rate`), and Hyperliquid, where it is a copy of `rate`. `null` on every other venue (about 93% of rows), including Binance, Bybit and OKX: read `rate` and `rate_kind` there.

margin_type.description: Collateral convention for the contract: `linear` (quote-margined) or `inverse` (coin-margined).

asset_class.description: Underlying category: `crypto`, `equity`, `commodity`, `fx` or `index`. Tokenized-equity perps such as Bybit `TSLL` are `equity`, not `crypto`.

mark_price.description: Binance's mark price for the base coin (from its premiumIndex feed), attached to every venue's row for that coin as context: it is not this venue's own mark or a traded quote. A lot contract such as `1000PEPE` carries Binance's lot price as is; a bare coin that Binance lists only as a lot is priced at the lot price divided by the lot size. `null` when Binance has no contract for the coin in the same asset class.

open_interest.description: Latest one-sided USD open interest (each contract counted once) for the `(exchange, base_coin)` pair when a matching futures row exists. `null` when no open-interest row matched. That is most rows, since open-interest coverage is narrower than funding coverage. Never `0` as a stand-in for missing.

market_cap_rank.description: Market-cap rank of the base coin, where `1` is the largest. `null` when the coin is unranked. Sort unranked rows last rather than treating `null` as a rank.

asset_id.description: The instrument master asset of this contract: the CoinGecko id when the asset was resolved strictly (`pepe`), otherwise `<class>:<ticker>` (`equity:bb`). Every contract of one asset carries the same id, whatever its base_coin spelling. `null` when the master does not know the contract.

asset_symbol.description: The asset ticker as a trader reads it: `PEPE` on the 1000PEPE and KPEPE contracts too. `null` when the master does not know the contract.

lot_multiplier.description: Units of the asset per unit the contract quotes: `1000` for Binance 1000PEPEUSDT (and for Coinbase 1000PEPE-PERP, whose base_coin is PEPE), `1` for Gate.io PEPE_USDT. From the venue or a checked alias, never parsed from the symbol. `rate` is a fraction of notional and needs no scaling. `null` when unknown.

instrument_status.description: The venue's own status for the contract, as the instruments sync last read it. `null` when the master does not know the contract.

is_live.description: `true`: trading, and the venue's contract list was read within 30 minutes. `false`: read within 30 minutes and not trading. `null`: unknown (no read in 30 minutes, a status value the sync could not interpret, or a contract the master does not know).

rate_8h.description: `rate` on the 8-hour basis: `rate × 8 / interval_hours`, so contracts on different intervals compare directly. `null` when the row has no rate or an interval Sharpe does not recognise, never computed from an assumed 8 hours.

apr.description: `rate` annualized over the row's own interval: `rate × 8760 / interval_hours`, a fraction (0.1 = 10%). Signed like `rate`. `null` when `rate_8h` is.

rate_kind.description: What `rate` (and so `rate_8h` and `apr`) measures on this venue: `estimate`, the in-progress rate for the settlement at `next_funding_time` (most venues: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, edgeX and others); `last_settled`, the rate charged at the last settlement, `next_funding_time − interval_hours` (Kraken, Crypto.com, Bitfinex); `trailing_8h`, funding realised over the last 8 hours, with `next_funding_time` on a synthetic 00/08/16 UTC grid (Deribit). Compare an `estimate` against a `last_settled` rate knowing they are one interval apart.

base_coin.description: The group's base ticker. Groups follow the funding grid: one per base_coin spelling and asset class, so `coin=PEPE` answers a `PEPE`, a `1000PEPE` and a `KPEPE` entry, and a ticker two asset classes share answers one entry per class.

funding_avg_8h.description: Average funding across venues on the 8-hour basis, over one primary contract per venue with a fresh rate (every venue's rate when none is fresh; see `funding_all_stale`). Weighted by each contract's one-sided open interest when at least two venues, and a majority of them, carry open interest; otherwise the median (`funding_method`). `null` when no venue has a usable rate, never 0.

funding_median_8h.description: Median of the same venues' 8-hour rates: the companion one venue cannot move.

funding_method.description: How `funding_avg_8h` was reduced: `oi_weighted`, or `median_fallback` when too few venues carry open interest. `null` with `funding_avg_8h`.

funding_venues_used.description: Venues behind the figures, one primary contract each.

funding_venues_stale.description: Venues left out because their rate was past the 10-minute freshness SLA while another venue was fresh.

funding_all_stale.description: `true` when no venue was fresh: the figures are then over the stale rates, and read as such.

highest.description: Up to N rows with `rate_8h` ≥ 0, highest first, among fresh rows with a usable interval that clear `min_oi_usd`. Empty when no such row has a rate at or above 0.

lowest.description: Up to N rows with `rate_8h` < 0, lowest first, among the same rows. A rate at or above 0 is never listed here, so this is empty when no eligible rate is below 0.

omitted.description: Rows of the scope left out, each under the first check it failed: `stale` (past the freshness SLA), `no_interval` (no rate or no usable interval), `below_floor` (open interest below `min_oi_usd`, or unknown while the floor is above 0).

funding_apr_mean.description: Mean 8-hour funding over one primary contract per (venue, asset) with a fresh rate, every asset class included, annualized (× 1,095): the computation behind `avg_funding_rate` on GET /v1/market/derivatives-overview, as an APR and without a key. `null` when no contract has a usable rate.

funding_apr_oi_weighted.description: The same, weighted by each contract's one-sided open interest (venues left out of open-interest totals carry no weight). `null` when no contract carries open interest, never the mean in its place.

positive.description: Primary contracts with a fresh rate above 0 (longs pay shorts).

negative.description: Primary contracts with a fresh rate below 0 (shorts pay longs).

coverage_ratio.description: Share of the span the contract was expected to settle in that its settlements cover: from its listing (its first settlement ever) or the window start, to its halt or now, with the last settlement credited one interval, and no more than the window's `covered_hours_*` when known (so a hole inside the span reads as missing). `null` when the contract was not expected in the window at all (listed after it, or halted before it).

complete.description: `coverage_ratio` is at least 0.9; `null` with the ratio. Compare `acc_*` of a complete window only with other complete windows.

listed_within_window.description: The contract's first settlement ever falls inside the window: a short history here is a new listing, not missing data.

halted_within_window.description: The contract stopped trading inside the window: the window is measured up to that halt. The halt is when the instrument master recorded the venue's status leaving trading; when the master has no such time (it first saw the contract already halted), it is the last settlement plus one interval once the contract's current row stopped updating or left the book. `false` when no halt time is known: then the window runs to now and missing settlements read as missing.

covered_hours_1d.description: Hours of funding the settlements summed in `acc_1d` stand for: the sum of their `interval_hours`. Fewer hours than the window (or than the contract's listed span inside it) means missing settlements, also in the middle of the window. It can exceed the window by up to one interval (a first settlement's interval reaches back past the window start). `null` when unknown.

covered_hours_7d.description: Hours of funding the settlements summed in `acc_7d` stand for: the sum of their `interval_hours`. Fewer hours than the window (or than the contract's listed span inside it) means missing settlements, also in the middle of the window. It can exceed the window by up to one interval (a first settlement's interval reaches back past the window start). `null` when unknown.

covered_hours_30d.description: Hours of funding the settlements summed in `acc_30d` stand for: the sum of their `interval_hours`. Fewer hours than the window (or than the contract's listed span inside it) means missing settlements, also in the middle of the window. It can exceed the window by up to one interval (a first settlement's interval reaches back past the window start). `null` when unknown.

covered_hours_90d.description: Hours of funding the settlements summed in `acc_90d` stand for: the sum of their `interval_hours`. Fewer hours than the window (or than the contract's listed span inside it) means missing settlements, also in the middle of the window. It can exceed the window by up to one interval (a first settlement's interval reaches back past the window start). `null` when unknown.

covered_hours_1y.description: Hours of funding the settlements summed in `acc_1y` stand for: the sum of their `interval_hours`. Fewer hours than the window (or than the contract's listed span inside it) means missing settlements, also in the middle of the window. It can exceed the window by up to one interval (a first settlement's interval reaches back past the window start). `null` when unknown.

asset_class.description: Underlying category, joined in from the live contract book. `null` when no live contract matches, rather than being defaulted to `crypto`.

margin_type.description: Collateral convention, joined in from the live contract book. `null` when no live contract matches.

interval_hours.description: The contract's own settlement interval, joined in from the live contract book. `null` when no live contract matches `(exchange, symbol)`. Expected settlements for a window are `ceil(window_hours / interval_hours)`. Compare `settlements_*` against that, never against a fixed 8-hour assumption.

is_active.description: `false` when the accumulated identity has no live contract behind it, meaning a delisted or renamed pair. Those rows keep their accumulated history but carry `null` metadata.

asset_id.description: The instrument master asset of this contract: the CoinGecko id when the asset was resolved strictly (`pepe`), otherwise `<class>:<ticker>` (`equity:bb`). Every contract of one asset carries the same id, whatever its base_coin spelling. `null` when the master does not know the contract.

asset_symbol.description: The asset ticker as a trader reads it: `PEPE` on the 1000PEPE and KPEPE contracts too. `null` when the master does not know the contract.
