is_live.description: `true`: trading, and the venue's contract list was read within 30 minutes. `false`: read within 30 minutes and not trading. `null`: unknown (no read in 30 minutes, a status value the sync could not interpret, or a contract the master does not know).

coverage.description: How much of each window (`acc_1d` … `acc_1y`) the contract's settlements cover, judged against when it was listed and when it stopped trading.

symbol.description: The contract that settled. A coin can span several contracts per venue (a USDT and a USDC perp, or PEPE beside 1000PEPE lots), so read series per (exchange, symbol).

OpenInterestExclusion.description: A venue whose stored open interest is published per venue but left out of every cross-venue total, and why. MEXC today: its holdVol moves 7.00x the position change of MEXC's own deal feed, so it fits neither side count.

estimated.description: True on the current window only: priced live from the in-progress rate and latest open interest, not from the matview.

rate_source.description: Where the current window's rate came from: `predicted` (the venue's `predicted_rate`, published only by Kraken, Crypto.com, Pacifica and Hyperliquid, where it equals `rate`), `current` (the row's `rate`), or `mixed` on a coin, venue or total row whose contracts used both. `current` is the normal path, and it is the forward estimate only where the funding book's `rate_kind` is `estimate`: on Bitfinex it is the last settled rate and on Deribit the trailing 8-hour realised rate, projected forward. `null` when no contract was priced.

coverage_ratio.description: Realised windows only: how much of the window is covered by priced history. Open interest accrues only forward, so a newly-priced venue's 7d column starts below 1.0. A coin, venue or total row is the open-interest-weighted mean of its contracts' ratios; a contract that stopped settling (halted or delisted) is expected only until its last priced settlement plus one interval.

partial.description: Realised windows only: true when coverage_ratio is below 0.9. The numbers still render -- partial means building history, not hidden.

complete.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: true when coverage_ratio is at least 0.9 (the opposite of `partial`).

listed_within_window.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: whether a contract behind the value was listed inside the window. Always `null` on this endpoint today: the settlement data prices seven days and carries no listing time, so a listing is unknown, never assumed.

halted_within_window.description: Realised windows with a coverage_ratio only: true when a contract priced in the window stopped settling inside it: its funding row left the live book or went stale, and its last priced settlement plus one interval falls in the window. Its coverage is measured only up to that point, so a halt does not read as missing history.

SettlementWindowValue.description: net = long_paid - short_paid. Both legs are always present alongside net -- a $0 net can conceal $50M flowing each way. Null means an unpriced/absent contract, never a zero flow.

excluded_from_totals.description: Present only on a venue whose open interest is priced per venue but left out of the coin row and the totals (MEXC today), with the reason.

price.description: Always `null`: no price source is wired into this endpoint (the settlement, funding and open-interest tables it reads carry no spot price). Use `/v1/market-cap/search` for spot price.

price_change_24h_pct.description: Always `null`, for the same reason as `price`.

venues.description: Present only when expand=venues is requested.

coins.description: Coins in the selected class, matching the scope of `totals` -- independent of any coin/exchange filter or pagination on this specific request.

updated_at.description: When the settlement data was refreshed (the funding_fee_settlement matview's refresh, every 15 minutes), not the request time.

oi_excluded_venues.description: Venues whose settlement dollars are left out of every coin row and the totals (shown only in the venues breakdown), with the reason.

total.description: Coins matching this request's coin/exchange filters, before pagination.

totals.description: Same net/long_paid/short_paid shape as a row, scoped to the selected `class`. crypto + rwa === all in every window, for net, long_paid and short_paid.

venueCount.description: Core venues (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Deribit, Hyperliquid) the coin sync observed listing a perp; 0 when none. Not the full venue coverage: funding and open-interest charts can serve more venues.

venues.description: The core venues counted by venueCount; empty when none was observed.

marketCapRank.description: CoinGecko market-cap rank; null when the coin has none.

status.description: "partial" when a database read failed or timed out after some rows arrived, or stopped at its row cap, so the oldest rows in the window can be missing; warnings says which. Omitted when every read completed.

warnings.description: One sentence per gap: an incomplete database read, a read stopped at its row cap, an open-interest history (oi-stacked, oi-change, oi-daily-change) above 30,000 rows resampled per venue to 2-, 4-, 6-, 12- or 24-hour buckets (last value per venue) to fit the response, an open-interest bucket that is the current (still filling) hour, or chart=cvd venues whose candles carry no taker buy volume.

open_interest_value.description: One-sided open interest in USD at the sampled price: a change between two rows includes the price move, not only positions opened or closed.

timestamp.description: The UTC hour bucket (its start). The value is the last ~10-minute sample the capture saw inside that hour, so it is about the OI at the bucket's END (it lines up with Binance openInterestHist at the next hour). The newest bucket is still filling while its hour runs; coverage.warnings names it.

The composite signal is not computed by the server: the rows are its raw inputs. Also on oi-volume's open-interest rows when they come from the live venue fallback. Absent elsewhere.

volume.description: Base-asset volume of the candle (not USD).

taker_buy_volume.description: Base-asset taker buy volume; null where the venue publishes none (only Binance candles carry it today, so CVD exists only for Binance).

volume_usd.description: Aggregated candles only (free route, downsampled 4h/1d buckets): the sum of each source candle's volume × its close. Null when a source candle lacks either.

cvd_delta_usd.description: chart=cvd, candles with taker volume only: (taker buy − taker sell) × close = (2 × taker_buy_volume − volume) × close, USD.

cvd_usd.description: chart=cvd, candles with taker volume only: the venue's cumulative volume delta, the running sum of `cvd_delta_usd` from the window's first candle, USD.

oi_total_usd.description: The coin's one-sided open interest across venues (engine L4 `oi.asset_total_usd`): each venue's latest reading within 6 hours, summed, rounded to whole USD. Venues in `oi_excluded_venues` are left out. Null when no venue has a reading within 6 hours (`oi_null_reason`).

oi_as_of.description: The oldest reading inside `oi_total_usd` (each venue's latest reading is hour-bucketed).

oi_null_reason.description: Why `oi_total_usd` is null (`no_eligible_inputs`: no venue reading within 6 hours). Present only then.

oi_excluded_venues.description: Venues that have a reading for this coin but are left out of the total, with the reason (MEXC today).

FuturesOiSummary.description: chart=oi-snapshot only: the coin's open interest summed across venues, computed by the server from the rows it returns.

openInterestExcludedVenues.description: Open-interest charts only (oi-stacked, oi-change, oi-daily-change, oi-snapshot): venues whose rows are shown per venue but must not be summed into a total, with the reason.

athDate.description: ISO 8601 time of the all-time high, as CoinGecko sends it. An empty string when CoinGecko sends none.

chainSlug.description: Preferred supported chain, used for the DEX link. Null when no supported chain is known.

chainSlugs.description: Every supported chain the asset is deployed on, in priority order, with chainSlug as the first entry. A multi-chain asset appears under each of these chains; an empty array means no supported chain is known.

lastUpdated.description: CoinGecko quote timestamp. Assets whose quote is older than 24 hours are excluded as no-longer-trading; a null value means the upstream omitted the field.

price.description: Crypto tab: the freshest of the coin's 1h futures candle close, its Binance mark from the funding book (5-minute refresh), the CoinGecko price (2-hourly) and the last daily close; null when the coin has none of them. RWA tabs: the venues' mark price.

priceChange24hPct.description: Crypto tab: from the 1h futures candles (about 100 coins the futures sync tracks), else CoinGecko's 24h change (top 100 by market cap); null for most of the long tail.

fundingRate.description: Funding fraction normalized to an 8h basis; never assumes the venue interval. Crypto tab: the coin's average across venues (the funding grid's Avg Rate), each venue's primary contract weighted by its one-sided open interest when at least two venues, and a majority of them, carry open interest, otherwise their median; only venues refreshed within 10 minutes; null when there is none. RWA tabs: the open-interest-weighted mean across RWA venues.

volume24hUsd.description: Crypto tab: 24h futures notional from the 1h candles, which cover only the ~100 coins the futures sync tracks, so most crypto rows are null (not measured, never spot volume).

marketCapUsd.description: Crypto tab: CoinGecko market cap, top 100 coins by market cap only (null below). Null on every RWA tab (no RWA market-cap source), including preipo and index, where no market cap exists.

liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto tab only: Velo's 24h liquidations on Binance, Bybit, OKX and Deribit (not every venue behind openInterestUsd); null for coins the futures sync does not track and on RWA tabs, where no venue publishes a liquidation feed.

venueCount.description: Venues behind openInterestUsd: on the crypto tab the distinct venues holding the asset's contracts (lot and quote spellings count once per venue); on RWA tabs how many venues list the underlying.

liquidations24hUsd.description: Crypto only, and a lower bound rather than a market-wide total: Velo's liquidations for four venues (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Deribit) over the coins the futures sync tracks (~85 rows carry one), summed over hourly buckets in a rolling 23-24h window, newest bucket still accumulating. Other venues behind openInterestUsd (Hyperliquid, Gate, Bitget, ...) are not included.

liquidationsLongUsd.description: Long side of the 24h liquidation total, so a cascade reads as flushed longs or shorts. Crypto only.

liquidationsShortUsd.description: Short side of the 24h liquidation total. Crypto only.

avgRsi.description: Unweighted mean Wilder RSI(14) on daily closes, top 100 crypto perps by market cap.

altcoinSeasonIndex.description: Share of the top 50 by market cap beating BTC over 90 days; excludes stablecoins and wrapped/staked derivatives.

openInterestExcludedVenues.description: Venues whose open interest every figure on the board leaves out, with the reason.

GlobalOverviewResponse.description: Market-wide metrics plus the ranked row table for one asset class. Paginated requests return rows only.

scope.description: The serve_snapshot scope, the cache row key, or the /global tab.

datasets.description: Per-dataset freshness; null when the database was unreachable (nothing was checked). A stale dataset does not make the service degraded.

x.description: Historical RVOL: current 24-hour volume divided by the asset's own average prior daily volume. Null when fewer than three positive historical observations are available.

3y.description: Always null today: the upstream market feed (CoinGecko /coins/markets) has no 3-year window.

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp for the populated heatmap cache.

coverage.description: Aggregate category coverage for narrative and ecosystem modes; null for coins mode.

oi_change_24h.description: Fraction, not percent (0.07 = +7%): 24 h change of USD-notional open interest summed over the venues read at both ends (MEXC excluded). USD, so a price move alone moves it.

cvd_trend_24h.description: Taker CVD trend over the newest 24 hourly candles, -1 to 1. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with taker-split candles).

basis_rate_avg.description: Mean perp basis across venues, a fraction. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with stored basis).

price_change_24h.description: Percent (5.4 = +5.4%), from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

price_change_7d.description: Percent, from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

holders_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

liquidity_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

volume_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

last_observed_at.description: Newest timestamp on this provider's rows (write, announce, first-seen, first-trade or effective time), capped at the response time; null when it returned no rows. Database: the newest row write or observation. Official overlay: the newest listing time the venue reports, not our fetch time (a scheduled pre-launch row's first_seen_at is the fetch time).

priceChange24h.description: 24-hour price change in percent (2.15 = +2.15%), from the CoinGecko snapshot taken when the coin was scored. Unlike priceChange7d and priceChange30d, this is not a fraction.

priceChange7d.description: 7-day price change as a decimal fraction (0.0875 = +8.75%), from hourly closes. Not a percent: multiply by 100 before comparing with priceChange24h.

priceChange30d.description: 30-day price change as a decimal fraction (0.0564 = +5.64%), from hourly closes. Not a percent: multiply by 100 before comparing with priceChange24h.

distanceFrom7dHigh.description: Price relative to the highest hourly close of the last 7 days, as a decimal fraction (-0.0426 = 4.26% below that high). Zero or negative.

distanceFrom7dLow.description: Price relative to the lowest hourly close of the last 7 days, as a decimal fraction (0.1245 = 12.45% above that low). Zero or positive.

oi_change_24h.description: Fraction, not percent (0.07 = +7%): 24 h change of USD-notional open interest summed over the venues read at both ends (MEXC excluded). USD, so a price move alone moves it.

cvd_trend_24h.description: Taker CVD trend over the newest 24 hourly candles, -1 to 1. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with taker-split candles).

basis_rate_avg.description: Mean perp basis across venues, a fraction. Null outside the futures-covered majors (the only coins with stored basis).

price_change_24h.description: Percent (5.4 = +5.4%), from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

price_change_7d.description: Percent, from the tracker cache (refreshed every few hours, accepted up to 24 h old), not measured by the scoring run.

holders_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

liquidity_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

volume_change_pct.description: Fraction, despite the name: change between the two most recent distinct on-chain snapshots (about 3 h apart). Null on a run with no newer snapshot than the previous row, never a measured 0.

burnPercent.description: Burned share of this pool's LP tokens in percent (0-100) from GoPlus, counting destroyed LP and LP held in Raydium's lock. Solana standard AMM pools only: null for concentrated-liquidity pools and on EVM chains.

pillar.description: `contract`: the Contract Security table; `health`: the Token Health table.

status.description: `neutral`: shown without a judgement (unknown, or an owner-only power of a renounced contract).

RugCheckCheck.description: One row of the /rug-check page's Contract Security or Token Health table.

value.description: 0-100, higher is safer. Null only when no provider answered (`data_completeness` `none`), never a default 50.

verdict.description: `safe` at 80 or more, `caution` at 50, `risky` at 20, else `danger`. Null when `value` is null.

verdict_label.description: The verdict as the page labels it. Null when `value` is null.

verdict_note.description: "Trusted issuer, centralised controls" when GoPlus trust-lists the token and its issuer can still mint, freeze, pause or upgrade it: those controls are listed as warnings but neither scored nor capped. Otherwise null.

data_completeness.description: `full`: the contract, holder and market pillars each had data. `partial`: one or two had none (each such pillar scores a neutral 50). `none`: no provider answered, so there is no score.

engine_version.description: Version of the scoring rules. A declared change to a weight, cap, band or check increments it, so a stored score can be told apart from one computed under other rules.

insights.description: The verdict's reasons as the page lists them, at most 6.

RugCheckScore.description: The Rug Check score the /rug-check page shows for this token, computed server-side (engine metric token_risk.rug_check) from this answer's GoPlus fields, the token's DexScreener market figures (liquidity and 24h volume summed over its pairs on this chain, age from its oldest pair) and its GeckoTerminal holder data. Weighted 0.40 contract, 0.35 holders, 0.25 market health, then capped by hard signals (a honeypot or sell block sets 5). An input a lookup could not read is unknown, never zero: it is left out of its pillar's average (its row reads `—`), a pillar with no data at all scores a neutral 50, and `data_completeness` says whether every pillar had data. On a `stale` answer the score is computed from the last good GoPlus record. Present on every 200 answer.

lpHolders.description: LP holders of the main pool (the deepest dexInfo entry). Each holder's percent is its share of that pool's LP token supply as a 0-1 fraction (0.0002 = 0.02%) on every chain; Solana shares are recomputed from the holder balance over the pool's LP amount. Null when the list cannot be tied to a standard AMM pool.

dexInfo.description: DEX pools, deepest first, so entry 0 is the main pool.

stale.description: Present and true only when the security provider was temporarily unavailable and this is the token's last good record (at most 7 days old). Absent on live answers.

dataAsOf.description: When the last good record was fetched. Present only alongside `stale`.

partial.description: Present and true only when the security provider was unavailable and the token has no last good record, on Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain or Base: `isHoneypot` comes from Honeypot.is's buy/sell simulation and every other security field is null (unknown). The score then treats the contract checks as unknown, except that a detected honeypot scores 5 (Danger). Absent otherwise.

checks.description: The rows of the /rug-check page's Contract Security and Token Health tables for this token, contract rows first, each in the page's order. Present on every 200 answer, beside `score`.

funding_rate.description: Funding as a decimal fraction per `interval_hours`: for the standard-funding venues the in-progress rate for the settlement at `next_funding_time` (Kraken's prediction, Orderly's `est_funding_rate`, Lighter's 8h-basis rate divided by 8 for its hourly charge), so `funding_rate × notional` estimates the next payment. GET /api/funding/rates serves Kraken's last settled rate for the same market instead (see its `rate_kind`). `null` when the venue published none.

interval_hours.description: Hours between this market's settlements: the span `funding_rate` is charged over, and the gap to `next_funding_time`.

funding_status.description: What funding_rate means now. live: non-zero. zero: exactly 0 while the underlying's home market is open, on a market that printed non-zero within 96 hours (a real 0). paused: exactly 0 while the home market is closed on a market that does fund (Bitget and Bybit stock perps settle 0 outside US hours). zero_by_design: exactly 0 with no non-zero print within 96 hours. none: no periodic funding (rollover venues). Only live and zero enter stats spreads.

fundingApr.description: Realised funding over the trailing windowHours: the settled rates summed and annualised (x 8760 / windowHours). Never one annualised print.

windowHours.description: Length of the realised window, in hours (24).

settlements.description: Settlements stored in the window. The market qualifies when they cover at least 90% of the window's hours (the hours each settlement stands for), not by their count.

RwaCarryMetric.description: Highest trailing-24h realised funding APR on a market with at least $1M open interest. Settlement history is stored for Hyperliquid and Kraken only, so best carry ranks those venues; null when none has at least 90% of the window covered by its settlements.

spreadApr.description: maxApr - minApr: the widest trusted cross-venue funding spread, this period annualised. Legs are funding_status live or zero only: a paused or by-design 0 is never a leg.

laggingVenues.description: Venue syncs behind the freshness threshold, oldest first; the rest are current. Empty when every venue is current.

pairUrl.description: DexScreener pair URL; may be empty when the upstream pair omits a URL.

priceChangeH1.description: 1h price change; null when the hour had no trades.

priceChangeH24.description: 24h price change; null when the day had no trades.

ageHours.description: Hours since the token's first DexScreener pair (ageBasis token), or since this pair was created when that lookup failed (ageBasis pair).

ageBasis.description: token: ageHours is the token's age (its earliest pair). pair: the token lookup failed and ageHours is this pair's age.

profile.description: Null when the token's DexScreener profile answer is unknown; the score then leaves the profile component out and renormalises the other weights.

boostVelocity.description: Unavailable until two real boost observations exist.

riskScore.description: Null when valuation coverage is incomplete.

fastDecay.description: Unavailable until a real decay time series exists.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique request identifier. Include this value when contacting support.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute for the authenticated API key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current one-minute rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the current rate-limit window resets.

X-Quota-Limit.description: Monthly request quota for the authenticated API key.

X-Quota-Remaining.description: Monthly requests remaining in the current billing period.

X-Quota-Reset.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the monthly quota resets, when available from the quota store.

X-Data-Source.description: The sources behind the rows, comma-separated source ids (e.g. `binance,bybit`): `meta.source`. /v1/funding/rates and /v1/rwa-perps/rates send the origin tier instead, `live` or `supabase`.

X-Data-Stale.description: True when the data is past its freshness SLA (`meta.freshness_status` is not `fresh`), judged for the answer as a whole; rows keep their own staleness flags. /v1/funding/rates and /v1/rwa-perps/rates set it when the response is empty or at least one returned row exceeds the published freshness target.

X-Data-Missing.description: Each configured venue that is not a quoted member of the board, comma-separated `Venue:reason`: `not_live` (the instrument master says every contract is halted; the venue is not asked), `stale` (no funding row inside the funding SLA), `no_ticker` (rows served unpriced: the venue has no bulk ticker, or its fetch failed). Absent when every venue is a quoted member.

X-Data-Venues.description: The venues a venue filter may offer, comma-separated: the configured venues the instrument master does not call not live.

X-Data-As-Of.description: When the data was current: `meta.as_of` (the newest live row, the snapshot or refresh time, or the fetch time). /v1/funding/rates and /v1/rwa-perps/rates: the newest source timestamp in the response.

X-Freshness-Sla-Seconds.description: The dataset's freshness SLA in seconds (`meta.freshness_sla_seconds`): the writer's cadence plus one skipped run.

X-Data-Availability.description: Whether dormant-producer data is historical or unavailable.

X-Producer-Status.description: Operational state of the dataset producer.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a per-minute rate-limit or monthly-quota rejection.

X-Coverage-Start.description: Oldest source timestamp represented in the response. Sent on type=history; absent when the window returned no rows.

X-Requested-Start.description: Start of the window the days parameter asked for, on type=history.

X-Coverage-Complete.description: False when the returned series starts more than 7 days after X-Requested-Start, or returned no rows at all. A short history is a 200 either way, so the shortfall is stated here rather than inferred.

X-Days-Clamped.description: True when days exceeded the 1095-day ceiling and the window was shortened. Always false on /v1, which rejects an out-of-range days value with a 400 instead of clamping it.

X-Data-Partial.description: Comma-separated database tables whose paged read failed or timed out after some rows arrived, so the series is missing rows. Absent when every read completed. The free /api/futures/data route also stops edge caching for such a response.
